summary: Cobble & Fog is a themed Unmatched set built around gothic/Victorian horror-adjacent heroes: Invisible Man, Sherlock Holmes and Watson, Dracula (with his brides), and Jekyll & Hyde, each with a distinct combat deck. Like other Unmatched sets it plays as tight, dice-free tactical combat on a point-to-point map, and mixes freely with other Unmatched boxes for new matchups.
praised: clever character-flavored mechanics (Invisible Man's fog, Jekyll/Hyde's dual forms)
fast, tactile combat with minimal downtime
great crossover potential with other Unmatched sets
criticised: four-player games are less balanced than duels
learning four new decks at once can be a lot for newcomers
Sherlock/Watson's two-unit control adds extra fiddliness

interaction.kind: asymmetric duel on a shared map
interaction.detail: As in other Unmatched sets, heroes and sidekicks share one map, contesting zones and lines of sight to block each other's movement and attacks. Combat cards resolve direct damage that can eliminate an opponent's characters outright.

subsystems: combat resolution reducing a hero's health
scoring.how_you_win: On your turn you move, play a scheme card, or attack an adjacent enemy hero with a matching-value card; the game ends the instant the opposing side's hero(es) are all reduced to 0 health, with no further point counting.
scoring.score_note: win by defeating opponent's fighters, no score

similar: Unmatched: Battle of Legends, Volume One
